APP_TITLE: Cibiyar Ilimi ta Majagaban Afirka - Waje
WELCOME_SUB: Kofa ta Karfafa Afirka Ta Hanyar Tsarin Pi
AFRICA_DAY: (Don Murnar Ranar Afirka Ta 25, An Kaddamar Da Wannan Manhajar Horas Da Majagaban Pi)
INTRO_P1: Pi Network wani aikin kudi na zamani ne na dijital da tsarinsa, wanda aka yi domin saukaka amfani da kudin crypto ga kowa da kowa.
INTRO_P2: Ba kamar sauran kudin crypto da suke bukatar manyan injuna masu tsada da wutar lantarki mai yawa ba, Pi Network yana baiwa talakawa damar shiga kai tsaye ta wayar salulansu.
INTRO_P3: Manufar Pi Network ita ce gina tsari wanda al'umma ke jagoranta, inda za a rika amfani da kudin dijital don ayyuka na gaskiya, hidima ta gaskiya, al'ummomi na gaskiya da kuma shiga tattalin arziki na gaskiya.
GLOBAL_MISSION: Babbar Manufar Pi Network Ta Duniya
M1: Gina tattalin arzikin dijital wanda ya kunshi kowa
M2: Karawa talakawa karfi a duk duniya
M3: Yada amfani da shi a rayuwa ta gaskiya
CH1_TITLE: BABI NA 1 — YIN RIJISTA DA FARAWANSHI
CH1_SUB: Barka da zuwa Cibiyar Ilimi ta Majagaban Afirka - Waje. An kirkiro wannan dandalin ne domin ilimantarwa, karfafawa da shirya majagaban Afirka da 'yan kasuwa don shiga cikin Tsarin Pi da gaske.
INVITE_LINK: Yi amfani da hanyar gayyata ta hukuma: https://minepi.com/chigalex1
REG2: Yi rijista da Facebook ko Lambar Waya
DAILY_MINING: Hakar Kullum: Ka dawo duk bayan awa 24 don ci gaba da hakar.
MC1: Kirkiro Wallet din Pi cikin aminci
WALLET_SEC: Tsaron Wallet: Kada ka taba bayyanawa kowa kalmomin sirri 24 na Passphrase dinka. Duk wanda ya mallaki kalmomin sirrin nan ne ya mallaki wallet din.
CH2_DESC: Koyi yadda ake karba da aika Pi cikin aminci ta amfani da Pi Wallet a cikin Pi Browser.
CH2A_TITLE: BABI NA 2A — HORO NA AIKATA PI WALLET
CH2A_DESC: Fara da dan kudi kadan don gwaji, tabbatar da adireshi, kada ka taba bayyanawa kowa kalmar sirrin ka.
CH3_TITLE: BABI NA 3 — FAHIMTAR TSARIN PI ECOSYSTEM
CH3_DESC: DApps na Pi Browser manhajoji ne masu zaman kansu don amfani na gaskiya.
CH4_TITLE: BABI NA 4 — MAPOFPI DA HADA KASUWANCI
CH4_DESC: Gano 'yan kasuwa masu amincewa da Pi a duk duniya.
CH5_DESC: Darajar Yarjejeniya ta Duniya (GCV) tana karfafa amfani na gaskiya a cikin tsarin.
CH6_DESC: Yi nazarin littafin Doris Yin don samar da amfani da habaka tsarin.
MERCHANT_DESC: Yadda za a shiga tsarin, jera kasuwancin ka a MapOfPi, da karbar biyan Pi.
FINAL_P: Afirka na da damar zama daya daga cikin yankuna mafi karfi wajen amfani na gaskiya a cikin Tsarin Pi. Tare Mu Gina. Tare Mu Ilimantar. Tare Mu Karfafa Afirka Ta Hanyar Pi.
